tessl_policy.evidence_retention: stable tmp staging is intentionally left for post-run inspection; reruns archive previous staged evidence under evidence-archive/
tessl_policy.project_identity_rule: plugin skills use the plugin project name; standalone skills use the skill name
tessl_policy.project_link_check: when --tessl-workspace is provided, repair/link existing project first and create only when needed

tessl_live_private_policy.project_identity_rule: plugin skills use the plugin project name; standalone skills use the skill name
tessl_live_private_policy.project_link_check: repair/link existing project first and create only when needed
tessl_live_private_policy.evidence_retention: stable tmp staging is intentionally left for post-run inspection; reruns archive previous staged evidence under evidence-archive/
tessl_live_private_policy.scenario_gate: skill-owned references/evals.yaml plus reviewed generated scenarios are required before live scoring; behavioral skills need at least 20 gold-standard scenarios; structure-only checks must opt out explicitly
tessl_live_private_policy.duplicate_run_guard: before live scoring, block when a pending eval run already exists for the same workspace/project

deterministic_local_gates: sdk eval regression-plan when prior Tessl or internal judge regressions exist

internal_judge_sequence.failure_rule: owner-classify failures in their source lane; rerun oss-local only when classification shows a local skill regression
owner-classify failures in their source lane; rerun oss-local only when classification shows a local skill regression

tessl_sequence.role: local Tessl lint, pack, temp install, and optional review proof before staged external scoring
package and scenario staging proof before external scoring
external confirmation lane after internal judges pass

pre_tessl_feedback_loop.failure_loop: Any oss-local, oss-cloud, Tessl local-proof, dry-run, or live Tessl failure stays in its source lane until owner classification identifies the repair surface; rerun oss-local only for classified local skill regressions.
pre_tessl_feedback_loop.live_blocked_until: deterministic gates, oss-local, oss-cloud, Tessl local-proof, and Tessl dry-run all pass for the current candidate or an explicit skip/blocker receipt is recorded.

model_selection_gate.acceptance: with-skill score must meet the quality floor and beat baseline before model cost can be treated as a selection advantage

run_limit_policy.preflight: before live scoring, check remaining Tessl workspace run capacity when the API/list surface is available; otherwise use the operator-provided 300-run cap and preserve reserve for rerun/remediation
run_limit_policy.block_when: remaining run capacity cannot be checked and the run is nonessential, or known remaining capacity is at/below reserve; use dry-run staging and local scenario gates instead

tessl_live_private_policy.readiness_gate: after run completion, fetch tessl eval view --json and require usage score >= 90% and usage score > baseline; 95% remains the target

lifecycle_events.event_definition: A workout, smoke eval, or proof run started for a capability.
A workout, smoke eval, or proof run completed with pass or fail status.

lifecycle_event.event_definition: A workout, smoke eval, or proof run completed with pass or fail status.

lifecycle_event_types.eval_started: A workout, smoke eval, or proof run started for a capability.
lifecycle_event_types.eval_blocked: A workout, smoke eval, or proof run stopped on a classified blocker.
lifecycle_event_types.eval_completed: A workout, smoke eval, or proof run completed with pass or fail status.

blocker_taxonomy.blocked_user_input: The runner requested user input and should not be treated as hung.
blocker_taxonomy.blocked_auth: The runner stopped on authentication or credential setup.
blocker_taxonomy.blocked_runtime: The runner was blocked by local runtime, sandbox, or model-capacity limits.
blocker_taxonomy.timeout_no_output: The eval timed out without producing final output.
blocker_taxonomy.timeout_partial_output: The eval timed out after producing partial output.
blocker_taxonomy.blocked_missing_tool: A required local command, runtime, package, or validator is unavailable.
blocker_taxonomy.blocked_missing_artifact: An expected report, transcript, output, or generated artifact is absent.
blocker_taxonomy.blocked_environment: The selected workspace, sandbox, cwd, or permission profile cannot run the check.
blocker_taxonomy.blocked_validation: A structural or policy validation gate failed for the capability.

data.tessl_dry_run_note: Tessl live-private dry-run validates the staged private Tessl payload only. Run without --tessl-live-dry-run only after deterministic local gates, oss-local, oss-cloud, and this dry-run pass for the current candidate.
